events.name: POST /backup-sessions
events.note: Create session S1 under token generation T0

events.name: 401 Unauthorized
events.note: The server spends its one allowed auth failure

events.name: 200 OK (token refreshed)
events.note: Token becomes T1; S1 is now invalid

events.name: PUT /backup-sessions/current/chunks/2
events.note: Retry only the failed chunk in stale S1

events.name: 204 No Content
events.note: Upload acceptance does not revalidate S1

events.name: 409 Invalid Session
events.note: Provengo's counterexample: S1 belongs to T0
